links.outcome: LLM performance variation by patient age and sex subgroups
links.effect: Increasing patient age was associated with mild but significant reduction in performance for ChatGPT-4.0, Meta AI, and Gemini; no age effect for ChatGPT o1-preview; sex had no significant impact.
links.quote: Increasing patient age was associated with a mild but statistically significant reduction in model performance for ChatGPT-4.0, Meta AI, and Gemini, while no significant age effect was observed for ChatGPT o1-preview; patient sex had no significant impact.

screen.reason: The study is an empirical benchmark comparing four commercial LLMs on histopathologic text descriptions without evaluating a specific organizational safeguard or deployment practice.
